name: Harvest 16-Bit
summary: Cozy SNES-era autumn farmland: warm hue-shifted pixel sprites, leaf-litter carpets, furrowed fields and wooden HUD panels.
description: A sunny autumn afternoon on the farm in true 16-bit pixel art: one art pixel per world unit, chunky 1-px coloured outlines, hue-shifted ramps that go plum in the shadows and butter-yellow in the light. Meadows in three greens, sunken dirt paths and furrowed soil fields, round orange/red/gold trees standing on carpets of fallen leaves. Every sprite is painted procedurally into a pixel grid with one shared top-left light, so the whole scene reads like hand-pixelled SNES-era farm art.
bestFor: top-down action games with many on-screen sprites

difficulty.why: New sprites must be pixelled as code primitives or text grids with 4 walk frames each, quantised ramps and the auto outline; small sprites go fast, but large detailed creatures (~52×58 px) and new tree or prop sets are painstaking detail work.

technique.resolution: Low-res buffer at 1 art pixel = 1 world unit (360 units of height ≈ 360 or fewer buffer rows, integer upscale = round(screenH / 360)), nearest-neighbour upscale to the display.
technique.summary: Every sprite is computed into a small pixel grid at init: shapes are ellipses/tapered leaves whose sphere normals are lit by one fixed light (-0.5, -0.6, 0.62) and quantised into 3–5 step hue-shifted ramps, then an automatic 1-px outline is added using the darkened average colour of the neighbouring pixels. The ground is baked per 256-unit chunk as a material map (grass, golden grass, clover, soil, path) with pixel edge rules, stamped tufts and leaves, and decals.
technique.linework: 1-px outline on every sprite, never black: each empty pixel next to a filled one gets the average colour of its 4-neighbours mixed 58–84 % toward ink plum #24162a (brighter colours get darker outlines). Ghosts use a fixed cool outline #33406c, gems #6a2a1a, seeds #5e3a2a. No anti-aliasing, no sub-pixel lines, no canvas strokes.
technique.shading: Quantised Lambert: ramp index = how many thresholds the light value passes (typical thresholds [-0.22, 0.14, 0.5, 0.8]). Ramps are hue-shifted (pumpkin #74282a → #ffc76c, root purple #2c1740 → #bf80c8). Pumpkin ribs are 1-px curves one ramp step darker; tree canopies add value noise (±0.15) for leafy clumping; no smooth gradients inside sprites.
technique.lighting: One warm light from the top-left-front for every sprite. Glows are additive stepped discs (3 hard alpha rings) for gems, lanterns and carved faces. A full-screen soft-light grade (warm orange top-left → cool blue bottom-right, 50 %) plus a multiply plum vignette (#966e96 at the corners) sets the afternoon mood.
technique.texture: Pixel-level only: grass tufts (5 stamp shapes), clover trefoils, leaf-litter stamps, furrow stripes every 6 px in soil, per-pixel hashed light/dark specks on paths and soil, and a ±4.5 % macro warm/cool colour drift.

paletteRules: Every material is a 3–5 step hue-shifted ramp: shadows drift toward purple/plum, highlights toward yellow/cream. Never darken by mixing with black.
The ground is ~85 % greens (#77963b, #9a9d45, #5b893f) and warm browns; saturated orange/red/gold comes from trees and leaf carpets (~15–30 % of the screen).
Characters are warmer and more saturated than the ground: pumpkin orange, root purple, cream, ember yellow. Ghosts are the only cool colour on screen.
Glow colours (#f2902a, #ffc640, #fff2a8) appear only in carved faces, eyes, gems, lanterns and sparkles.
No pure black and no pure white except 1-px sparkle centres and the white impact-flash silhouette.
Outlines are always tinted versions of the object's own colour (mixed toward #24162a), never a uniform black line.

world.summary: An endless autumn farmland baked per 256×256-unit chunk at 1 px per unit: noise-driven meadow patches in three greens, a winding sunken dirt path, rounded-rectangle ploughed fields with furrows and crop rows, and leaf-litter pools under each tree — single leaves scattered along the rim, calm litter with drifts inside. Raised grass edges get bright rims and dark lips, lower soil and path get a 2-px dithered shadow band, which fakes 16-bit height.
layers: Material map per pixel: PATH (domain-warped Perlin iso-line at 980-unit scale, half width 8.5–14.5 units), SOIL (rounded-rectangle fields 150–290 × 96–190 units, corner radius 6, max one per 400×300 cell), else CLOVER / GOLD / GRASS from two fbm fields (scales 360 and 430 units) with a 64×64 tileable jitter so borders are ragged.
Pixel cleanup: remove 1-px spurs between height classes so edges are clean pixel art.

Detail stamps: grass tufts on a 7×6 grid (density driven by a 52-unit mottle noise), clover trefoils on a 5×4 grid, leaf stamps on a 3×3 grid whose survival depends on leaf density (organic carpet edges). Leaves scatter along the carpet rim, the inside is a calm litter pool with clustered drifts (mottle mask), never an even confetti.

Colour pass with edge rules: bright rim on grass below a raised edge, dark lip above a drop, 2-px dithered shadow band where soil/path meet grass from above, furrow stripes (period 6, ramp #a26e44 … #50332f) in soil, ruts #9e7a50 and hashed specks on paths.
Macro tint: multiply each pixel by 0.955–1.045 with a slight warm/cool shift from a 1100-unit noise.

Decals stamped deterministically across chunk borders: flowers (5 petal colours), tiny flowers, mushrooms near leaves, mini pumpkins and rocks in meadows, twigs, pebbles and edge stones on paths, sprout/root-bulb crop rows every 8 units on field ridges. 's' pixels multiply the ground as a 1-px shadow.

characters.summary: Chibi 16-bit sprites built in code: a main character about 22×30 px (a big round carved-pumpkin head on a short caped body), then creatures in their own hue families: a small purple root creature with a leafy top (20×26), a fast translucent ghost (22×28) and a large lumpy ochre-and-purple root colossus (52×58). Ellipse forms are lit by the shared light and quantised into hue-shifted ramps, details placed pixel by pixel, and an automatic coloured 1-px outline is added. Sprites face right; the left version is a mirrored copy. 4 walk frames (bob 0/-1, legs ±2 px, arm swing, cape/scarf flap) and 2 idle frames.
rules: Head-heavy chibi proportions: head ≈ 14 px tall on a 30 px sprite, legs 2 px wide, boots 3 px.
Every sprite gets the automatic coloured outline; never draw outlines by hand. Only ghosts use a fixed cool outline #33406c.
Faces glow: carved triangle eyes and jagged grins use the 3-step glow ramp #f2902a/#ffc640/#fff2a8 with a 1-px dark cut lip above each hole.
Anchor every sprite at its feet (bottom centre) and draw it at integer coordinates.
Each creature type owns one hue family: purple/magenta root creatures, cold blue ghosts, ochre/purple colossi.
Paint every sprite facing right with the light from the top-left; the left-facing version is a plain mirrored copy (the light flips with it, which is invisible at this size).
Bake extra variants once: a brighter-glow set for face flicker, a white flash silhouette and a #ffc36a afterimage silhouette.

Main character walk: 8 poses (contact, down, passing, up × 2) from a pose table, body bob [0,1,0,-1,…], near arm swinging against the near leg, cape and scarf tail lagging a step, the head landing one frame after the body.

Idle: breath every 1.15 s with the head 0.14 s behind, blink every 3.6 s, cape stir every 4.6 s; dash = 50 ms crouch → stretch pose with tinted afterimages → 120 ms skid; hurt = recoil pose alternating with its white silhouette.

Small creatures get a squash pose (rx 8.8, ry 6, eyes shut) for ~120 ms after hits (2-px recoil) and for the disappear pop; ghosts float on an eased 8-step lift and rise while thinning out when they disappear.
Every figure has its own animation phase; sprites bake lazily per pose and are warmed at init.

props.summary: Farm scenery painted with the same pixel painter, lit ramps and auto outline as the characters: round autumn trees (56×65 / 68×80 px) built from 13 overlapping noisy blobs in orange, red, gold or turning-green canopy ramps, plus hay bales, wooden fences, pumpkin patches, scarecrows, stumps, wheelbarrows and crates in wood #3e2420 … #d8aa6a and straw #7a5a2a … #faeaa0 ramps. Every prop stands on a plum pixel shadow and is y-sorted with the characters.
rules: Trees: per pixel the blob with the highest sqrt(r²−d²)+z supplies the normal; light ×0.85 + 0.1, minus a 0.24 top→bottom falloff, plus value noise ±0.15, quantised into a 5-tone canopy ramp; bark trunk #3a2228 … #9e6c44 with root flare, forked branches and a dark canopy shadow band on the upper trunk.
Every tree stands on a leaf-litter carpet in its own colour; canopies drop to 60 % opacity when the main character is behind them.
Hay bales: square 26×19 (lit top 6 rows, twine bands #c8643e at x 7 and 18) or round 28×20 lying cylinder with a spiral end.
Fence 34×20: three 3-px posts and two 3-px rails in the wood ramp, lit top pixels, nail pixels #4a4450.

Scarecrow 30×48: post and crossbar, plaid shirt #7a2230/#b8402f/#e0603e/#f2a07a with blue grid lines #3a3a6a/#5a5a96, patch #d8b060, burlap head #8a6a4a … #ecd6a4 with stitched face #3a2420, straw hat #8a5a2a/#b07a3a/#c89048 with red band #a83a2e, optional crow #1e1a28/#34304a/#504c6a with beak #f0b040.

Pumpkin patch 38×20 (two lit ribbed pumpkins with vines and leaves), stump 22×14 with rings #c8945a/#e2b878, wheelbarrow 30×20 with pumpkins and a #3a3040/#7a7080 wheel, crate 18×18 with root bulbs and leaves peeking out.
Prop shadows (width in px): big tree 50, small tree 40, hay 28, fence 36, pumpkins 30, scarecrow 18, stump 22, wheelbarrow 28, crate 18, offset 1–3 px right.
Each prop gets a mirrored copy for variety; place them deterministically per cell (fences and scarecrows on field edges, hay/barrows/crates near fields, stumps in forests).

effects.name: Seed projectile
effects.how: 5×3 cream seed sprite (4 rotation frames, outline #5e3a2a) plus two trailing 1-px dots #fff2c8 at 4 and 6 units behind with alpha 0.55 and 0.28.

effects.name: Impact flash + sparkle
effects.how: The struck creature swaps to a pre-baked white silhouette while flash > 0.45; a 5×5 plus-shaped sparkle (#ffe9a0/#ffc84a/#ffffff) shrinks through 3 frames; leaves (2×2 particle frames) flutter off (55 % chance, gravity 22, drag 1.5). Ghosts emit vapour puffs instead.

effects.name: Burst
effects.how: 8 (large creature: 16) square 2–3 px chunks in the sprite's ramp colours with a 1-px highlight, thrown up with gravity 200, plus 3–6 fluttering leaves, 2–5 dust puffs and an expanding 1-px pixel ring #fff4d0 (r 3 → 11, large 6 → 22, 0.22 s). Ghosts burst into 7 vapour puffs and a pale ring.

effects.name: Rise from soil
effects.how: Creatures rise out of the ground: the sprite is cropped from the top (eased outQuad) above a 12×3 dirt mound sprite; dirt chunks #6e4632/#9a663f fly out. Ghosts instead fade in and sink 8 units with vapour puffs.

effects.name: Collectible gem
effects.how: 3×5 amber gem (large: 5×7 teal #5ce0c8/#2aa8a0/#1a6a70) bobbing 1 unit, over a tiny pixel shadow, with an additive stepped glow disc (r 3, #ff9030) pulsing 0.5±0.15 and a sparkle every ~1.25 s; pops out on a 9-px arc.

effects.name: Dash smear
effects.how: 3 afterimages tinted #ffc36a, spaced 7 units back along the dash, alpha 0.16/0.32/0.48, plus dust puffs.

effects.name: Falling leaves
effects.how: 2–3 px leaf frames (4 rotations) drift from visible tree canopies and 9 wind-blown leaves wrap across the view (16–27 units/s right, 7 units/s down).

effects.name: Ring burst
effects.how: A 1-px pixel ring #ffd25a squashed to half height grows from radius 6 to 40 around the main character, plus 14 radial sparkles and 6 leaves.

atmosphere.summary: A warm late-afternoon light: one top-left light baked into every ramp, two-step plum pixel shadows under everything, stepped additive glow discs for glowing faces, gems and lanterns, and a full-screen soft-light grade (warm orange top-left → cool blue bottom-right) with a plum multiply vignette. No blur, fog or smooth gradients in the world itself.
rules: Shadows: pixel ellipses w × round(w·0.36) in rgb(40,22,56), alpha 92 inside q ≤ 0.55 and 62 outside — two hard steps, never blurred, offset +1…3 units right. Widths: main character 14 (12 while dashing), small creature 14, ghost 10 (at 55 %), large creature 32, trees 50/40.

Glows are additive ('lighter') discs with 3 hard alpha rings, never radial gradients: gem r 3 #ff9030 (.26/.06), large gem r 5 #40d0c0, lantern r 11 #ffa040 (.32/.1) flickering to r 13, main character face r 9 #ffb040.
Grade: linear gradient rgba(255,190,110,.55) top-left → rgba(255,170,100,.18) → rgba(80,90,160,.42) bottom-right, composited soft-light at alpha 0.5.
Vignette: radial white → rgb(150,110,150) (inner radius 0.35·min(W,H), outer 0.62·diagonal) composited multiply. Grade and vignette are pre-rendered once per buffer size.
Ground fake height: bright rims and dark lips on grass edges plus the 2-px dithered shadow band where soil and path sit below grass.
Decal shadows are single multiply pixels (r×0.72, g×0.7, b×0.8); ghosts are drawn at 86 % opacity; canopies drop to 60 % opacity over the main character.

ui.summary: Nailed wooden planks: #8f5c34 panels with horizontal grain lines, 3 px dark border #2b170f, bevel (inset light #b97f4b / dark #5e3820), four 3×3 cream nail heads in the corners and a hard 4 px drop shadow. Bars are inset dark troughs with banded flat fills (no gradients), red #ffa58a/#ee4f36/#c0302c/#8e1f2a or amber #fff0a0/#ffc94a/#f19434/#c8621f with 3-px dark notches every 12 px. Text is pixel fonts with chunky 8-direction text-shadow outlines. Cards are parchment (#f6e6bc → #ead096) with a 4 px #4a2a18 border and a red pin.

motion: Main character: 8-pose walk at floor(anim × 1.3) & 7 (≈ 12 fps at walking speed) with counter-swinging arms, the head one frame behind the body and the cape lagging a step; footstep dust on the two down poses.
Idle: breath 1.15 s (head 0.14 s later), blink every 3.6 s, cape stir every 4.6 s, per-figure phase offsets.
Dash: 50 ms crouch → stretch + 3 tinted afterimages → 120 ms skid; throw arm ~90 ms after each shot.
Small creature ≈ 6 fps, large creature ≈ 2.6 fps with foot-fall dust, ghost 6 fps with an eased 8-step float [0,0,1,2,3,3,2,1] at 5 fps.
Hit: white silhouette while flash > 0.45 plus the squash pose and a 2-px recoil for ~120 ms. Disappear: white squash pop → crumpled hold → burst; ghosts flash, rise and thin out.
Appear: roots climb out of a dirt mound with soil chunks; ghosts rise while fading in with vapour.
Gems bob 1 px and pop up 9 px when they appear; numbers pop 2–3 px for 0.08 s; everything moves in whole art pixels.
do: Render everything into a low-res buffer at 1 art pixel per world unit and upscale by an integer factor with imageSmoothingEnabled = false.
Build sprites procedurally into a pixel grid: ellipse/leaf primitives lit by the one shared light, quantised into hue-shifted ramps.
Let the baker add a 1-px outline coloured from the neighbouring pixels, darkened toward #24162a.
Give the ground height: grass edges get a bright rim or dark lip, paths and soil a 2-px dithered shadow band under the grass.
Scatter leaf-litter carpets in the tree's own colour under every tree; use fbm noise so meadows show three greens.
Use stepped (3-ring) additive glow discs instead of radial gradients.
Finish with the warm soft-light grade and the plum multiply vignette.
Keep pixel decals tiny (1–7 px) and give them 1-px multiply shadow pixels.
dont: Don't use smooth gradients, blur, or canvas strokes/arcs on sprites — it breaks the pixel grid.
Don't draw at fractional coordinates or upscale by non-integer factors.
Don't use black outlines or pure black shadows; shadows are plum (40,22,56) at 36 %/24 % alpha.
Don't light sprites from different directions; every ramp assumes top-left light.
Don't cover the ground with flat colour; without tufts, rims and specks it looks like a placeholder.
Don't add neon or cold saturated colours outside the ghost/ice family.
Don't mix pixel scales (e.g. 2× sprites over 1× ground).
Don’t animate with 2–4 near-identical frames or same-side arm and leg swings, and don’t sprinkle leaves or tufts evenly.
performance: All sprites (main character 2 glow variants × 4 walk + 2 idle × 2 facings, creatures, flash silhouettes, trees, props, icons, digits) are baked once in init into small canvases; per frame only drawImage blits happen at integer positions into the low-res buffer, then one nearest-neighbour upscale. The ground is the hot spot: each 256×256 chunk evaluates several fbm fields on a 4-unit grid (bilinear), a per-pixel material map with SDF fields and stamps, so it is built as a generator that yields every 32 rows and is cached. The screen overlays (grade + vignette) are pre-rendered once per buffer size. Main-character poses bake lazily into a Map keyed by the pose fields (walk, idle, dash, hurt warmed at init).
